segments.text:
V. 2.
The time cometh, that whoſoever killeth you, will think he doth God ſervice—But bleſſed be GOD, the Time is ſo far paſt, that thoſe who bear the Name of Chriſt, do not now generally ſuppoſe they do Him Service, by killing each other, for a Diſſerence in Opinion or Mode of Worſhip.
